entries.message: We are currently addressing an issue affecting services in our Mumbai location. Our network engineers are working with onsite technicians to identify the cause and restore affected services as quickly as possible.

We are currently investigating intermittent DNS resolution failures affecting some requests.

Our team is actively working to identify the cause and restore consistent resolver performance. We will provide additional updates as more information becomes available.

We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience while we investigate.

We are aware of an issue affecting services in our Singapore location. The cause is due to inclement weather involving Typhoon Dujuan which resulted in a global sub-sea cable cut. 
Our engineers will continue to monitor the status of this outage until it is resolved.
An outage or maintenance window is affecting a subset of users in this region. Detailed outage information is available in the customer portal if this event is impacting your resources.
